text:
maria: main turned red after merge of #5423 — smoke hung on the 'deploy-smoke' stage, logs stuck at 'waiting for response'. pipeline: https://ci.redwood/internal/pipelines/abcd1234 :exclamation:
ops-bot: CI alert: pipeline abcd1234 failed step deploy-smoke (timeout). build=98765. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/98765
alex: I can take a look. pinging @jia for artifacts. did anyone reproduce locally?
jia: looking now. quick tail shows:
```
...
GRPC shard 3: read timeout
worker-2: exited with code 137
...
```
jia: exit code 137 is OOM-ish. also seeing repeated cuda memory allocation errors in the node logs.
maria: PR 5423 touched the prefetch/batching window, right? that could increase peak mem under some seq lengths. @alex did your change increase prefetch size?
alex: yeah small bump to prefetch to reduce cold-start latency. shouldn't blow memory usually but could on long sequences. I'll try a local bisect and also request a rerun at larger machine size.
oncall-sre: if you need immediate unblock: revert is fastest. alternatively rerun with larger flavor. command: `ops-bot rerun 98765 --flavor large` to test.
alex: ops-bot, please rerun with larger flavor: `ops-bot rerun 98765 --flavor large`
ops-bot: rerun queued by alex -> new build 98766 (flavor=large).
jia: I'll start a bisect on the CI matrix in parallel to see correlation with PR 5423.
maria: if 98766 passes we likely need a safety cap on prefetch. if it fails we should revert. please keep incident notes.
ops-bot: build 98766 started. runner=gpu-12
oncall-sre: build 98766 failed — same pattern. node logs: `cudaError: out of memory` then worker reaped.
jia: confirmed. bisect across commits points to PR 5423 as the introducing change.
alex: thanks — I'll open a revert PR and follow up with a safer patch that caps prefetch and adds mem-usage tests. tagging @maria for priority.
maria: thanks. @oncall-sre set low severity and proceed with revert. we need a follow-up action: add mem-regression CI test and update the runbook for prefetch changes.
oncall-sre: incident marked low-sev. revert PR: https://git.redwood/changes/5423-revert (merging now to restore main).
alex: merged revert, watching main. once green i'll open the fix PR that adds a configurable cap + unit test. also propose quarantining the noisy smoke until we stabilize.
jia: will add that smoke to quarantined tests and add the mem-regression job to the nightly matrix.
maria: perfect. please paste links to the follow-up PRs in the incident doc. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
ops-bot: main pipeline is green again after revert (build 98770).
